530. Robot Path Finding

Problem Statement:
Friday is a path finding robot. A tiled room is modelled as a binary matrix and is fed into the robot. A value of 1 implies that the robot can move on that tile. A value of 0 means the otherwise. Starting at location (0,0) find out whether friday can reach the corner of the room at (N-1,N-1) where N is the number of rows and columns in the square matrix.Note: The robot cannot move backwards. However it can move in any of the other directions(including diagonal).
input_spec: Dimensions of the matrix followed by the elements in the matrix ( 0 or 1 )
output_spec: “yes” if the robot can reach the corner. “no” if it cannot.
